notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
In this update we've added two new guns, the: SKS and M4. 

There's been some map changes which are quite important including lighting and shadow changes, as well as weather. 

The M14 sights have been adjusted to make the weapon easier for use.

Grenade particle effects have been changed to look better.

Crouching has been changed some as well as some of the character animations.

Guns can now be picked up on Dusttown, such as: MP7 and AWP.

Photon voice has been shut off, meaning players can no longer speak to each other in game and will have to use an external voice app for voice communications. Text chat in game is still available.

The fire sound on the M14 has been changed.

Colliders were fixed on Northern Fight.

notes.title: UPDATE, thankfully ;)
notes.notes:
Hey Y'all,

Lighting and shadow fixes. The maps have been enlightened, shadows are not as dark also.

The floating trees on Northern Fight map fixed, and the ambient audio reduced.
Have one of the houses on Desert Defiance re textured, one more to go. 
Increased/improved the visual quality, that goes for all maps, weapons, player models, etc...
Reduced kills needed for airstrike from 7 to 6. Attack Apache kills reduced from 10 to 8.
Made the circle on the m14 sight thinner, so you can see much better now.

We are currently working on; a fatigue indicator, compass, increased weapons volume, reducing the hit indicator effect, And dealing with some spawn issues, where enemies spawn to close on death match. Arguing about the hit indicator, again!

More to come!

Best Wishes, Veteran Soldier

notes.title: UPDATE WOOHOO!
notes.notes: In this update there were some bug fixes on dust town and northern fight, some lighting changes to appalachian ambush and walking speed has been lowered by .5. Order of guns and grenades has changed, m16-a4 being the first primary weapon available now and audio grenade being beneath flash grenade in selection.

notes.title: Gameplay changes and bug fixes
notes.notes:
GAME PLAY: The leaning system has been changed / the M16-A4 animations have been improved / some weapons are now locked (will require leveling up to unlock) / Dust Town has been altered / minor changes to HUD / 

BUGS: In game voting has been disabled until fixed. Fixed

notes.title: Game play changes and minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
The CX-8 SMG damage has been increased, Makarov damage and range increased, M16-A4 has a new reticle on the Holographic sight, M9 and C1911 handguns has less recoil, MPX and MP7 have animation changes, some character model animations regarding hand inverse kinematics have been fixed, all automatic weapons now have tracer rounds which are also now visible from the third person world view. 

Another update with fixes to the in game voting is expected to be out later today or tomorrow. Thank you. - Desert Fox, 522 Studios
